items.title: Johnny Lala Interview, 1960-03-15
items.q: Oh, the Jack Lange. He might be on someone. I'll tell you where they are, too. Then I heard that he had a job with Mae West traveling around after that.

ctx.x: Yeah, he should be dead. See, we had a fellow with us.

I bet you Johnny would like to see them old pictures you've got downstate. I'd like to see them. We'll come around here in the day. Yeah. See the pictures they've got. Oh, the Jack Lange. He might be on someone. I'll tell you where they are, too. Then I heard that he had a job with Mae West traveling around after that.
And then I didn't hear it.
